name: pgatzka-plugins
description: Philipp Gatzka's personal Claude Code plugin and skill collection. Domain-agnostic — anything I use often enough to want it on every machine ends up here.

plugins.name: java-development
plugins.description: Personal Java development helpers. Includes structured logging (SLF4J), Javadoc, Lombok, and Spring Boot conventions.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Personal git workflow helpers. Currently includes .gitignore conventions (minimal, anchored, sorted entries).

plugins.name: build-tools
plugins.description: Personal build-tool conventions. Three principles: don't build unless required, never check in generated code, run the minimum invocation the goal needs. Tool-agnostic core with per-tool notes for Maven, Gradle, npm/pnpm/yarn, Cargo, Go.

plugins.name: ci-cd
plugins.description: Personal CI/CD pipeline conventions. Core principle: DRTT — Don't Run Things Twice. Build once, consume the artifact in downstream jobs. Plus version pinning, least-privilege permissions, secrets discipline, fail-fast parallelism, every-step-has-a-verdict, concurrency control, timeouts, OIDC for cloud auth, and reproducibility.

plugins.name: sql-development
plugins.description: Personal SQL / relational database helpers. Currently: database-design (schema conventions, audit columns, dialect-aware rules, online migration safety, ASK-first on every undecided detail).

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Personal workflow skills and session-lifecycle commands. Skills: ask-user-questions (one-topic-per-question discipline for AskUserQuestion), persist-project-preferences (durable preferences land in CLAUDE.md, not local memory), definition-of-done (9-item self-check before claiming a coding task is finished). Commands: /session-handoff (capture session state at end), /session-pickup (read it on the next session).

plugins.name: documentation
plugins.description: Personal documentation skills. Currently: readme (strict-minimum README discipline) and wiki (GitHub Wiki via submodule, five-category Diátaxis+Development taxonomy, post-task doc-update check), plus /readme-init and /wiki-init commands.
